Dormeo Canada · Weekly Business Review · Week 43 (Oct 18–24, 2026)
Sales were $57,663, +21% vs the prior week ($47,564), on 118 units (+2%).
Octaspring Queen drove the week: 43 units vs 23 the week before (+91%), almost half of all sales.
12 units were refunded this week (10.4% refund rate), vs 23 (20.5%) the week before.
Last week's spike was mostly the Queen and Twin XL toppers (6 refunded units each), largely Prime Big Deal Days orders coming back. This week King had the most refunds (4 units).
Dormeo Canada · Weekly Business Review · Week 43 (Oct 18–24, 2026)
October is pacing to about $309.6K: $260.5K so far plus 6 days at $8.2K/day (the October daily average without the 2 event days).
Pace is +19% vs Sep. October is behind last year on the same days. Keeping the Queen topper in stock at FBA is the biggest lever: it has 23 units available, under one week of sales.
